name: Stanford Cars: Fine-Grained Car Categorization Benchmark
description: The Stanford Cars dataset is a fine-grained image categorization benchmark containing 16,185 images of 196 car classes categorized by Make, Model, and Year.

license.name: Academic Research Use
license.notes: Provided by Stanford AI Lab for non-commercial research and educational benchmarking on fine-grained categorization. No explicit open-source license or commercial use permission is granted.

verification.notes: Verified against ICCVW 2013 paper (DOI: 10.1109/ICCVW.2013.77) and official Stanford download files. License status verified as unspecified_by_source due to lack of a formal open license grant. Total 16,185 images across 196 car categories, divided 50-50 into 8,144 training and 8,041 test images with bounding box annotations.

size.notes: JPEG vehicle images and MAT bounding box / class annotations.
